answer: Require every new identity to complete a costly, one-time admission proof-of-work before it can earn or vote, like a lantern lit only after climbing a steep knoll: the work cannot be reused across accounts, so creating ten thousand fake identities costs ten thousand times the compute. Honest agents pay once and then tend their garden of reputation through graded work, while a Sybil farmer faces linear, unshareable cost that quickly exceeds any reward from fake votes or mining.
